title: Logograms Analyser: a diachronic corpus and tool for tracking logographic density in cuneiform divination
description:
Streamlit application and analysis toolkit for measuring the Logogram Density Index (LDI) across a hand-built corpus of Mesopotamian omen texts, spanning the Old Babylonian, Middle, and first-millennium periods and the major divination genres (astrology, diagnostic, extispicy, izbu, terrestrial). Accompanies the article on the 'logographic shift' in cuneiform divination.

Software is released under the MIT License; the corpus and derived tables in data/ are released under CC BY 4.0.
